current_state_problems_addressed.problem_1_no_pre_certification_scan: 89.5% readiness failure rate resolved by pre-flight gate (Gates 1-4, 12 scans, ~8min pipeline). Items structurally clean before Quality Board review. Target: <12% readiness failure.
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_2_qid_identity_broken: QID-only identity caused DL-029 (257 Pack B false positives), S320 (wrong variants targeted), DL-008 phantom counts. Resolved by Registry Board compound-key model (QID + CorrectChoice + EW_Pattern + Template_Family + File_Path).
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_3_cross_board_duplication: 2.5:1 duplication ratio (peak 6.2:1). EW fields examined 4-7 times per session. Resolved by Quality Board single-pass review with 3 sub-agents covering all 10 CAQS dimensions. Scan once, consume many.
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_4_no_delta_review: 80% unchanged items re-audited every wave. S809 chain: 4 sessions, 60 agent-spawns, 0 writes. Resolved by Throughput Board delta ledger — SHA-256 content hashing, only changed items reach Quality Board (target: <20% review rate).
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_5_runaway_reporting: 1,227 files, 65% unconsumed, 3.5:1 metric duplication. Resolved by 4-report target per session: DASHBOARD.json, SESSION_SUMMARY.md, QUALITY_BOARD_VERDICT.json, CERTIFICATION_RESULTS.json.
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_6_scan_methodology_fragility: DL-029 forward-scan false positives produced 67 phantom DL-008, 257 Pack B ghost counts. Resolved by AM-1 Function Constructor Parse mandated for ALL scans. Within-object extraction only. DL-029 structurally eliminated.
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_7_template_engine_defects: 5-item rotation template systematically injected DL-008/025/026/013/016/030/031. ~25 sessions consumed on template-injected defect remediation. Resolved by pre-flight gate catching template defects before board entry + S311 EW Factory standard for all new content.
current_state_problems_addressed.problem_8_no_concurrent_session_coordina: DL-019 overwrite: 432 items. DL-028: ~200 empty slots. Resolved by Governance Board session-level exclusive file access + pre-write/post-write hash reconciliation + post-remediation reconciliation gates.

target_state.label: Framework v2 — Consolidated, Automated, Identity-Aware, Delta-Driven
target_state.scan_redundancy_target: 1 per defect class per session (down from 3-12x)
design_principles: Each board produces a DISTINCT output no other board produces
Scan once, consume many — no board re-runs independent scans of defect classes
Within-object extraction only — AM-1 Function Constructor Parse is the sole approved methodology
Compound-key identity — all boards reference Registry Board identity, never derive CC from QID alone
Delta-driven — only genuinely changed items reach Quality Board; unchanged items inherit prior verdict
Automated pre-flight — items are structurally clean before human review begins
Single-source-of-truth per dimension — no duplicate within-session review of any field
Governance separation — the board that authorizes write is never the board that performs review
Phase-gated throughput — Throughput Board metrics gate Phase 2/3 activation, preventing premature deployment

consensus_model.rule: ALL_AGREE required for CERTIFIABLE verdict. 2 of 3 core agents (Agent 1, 2, 3) must agree CERTIFIABLE. If Agent 4 is active, 3 of 4 must agree.
consensus_model.certifiable_threshold: 10-dimension CAQS rubric score ≥ 90 (Exam-Ready tier) OR ≥ 70 (Acceptable tier) with documented exception justification
consensus_model.needs_revision_threshold: Any sub-dimension FAIL → HOLD with per-dimension resolution path. Specific slot and remediation instruction provided.
consensus_model.reject_threshold: CAQS Dimension 3 (Technical) score = 0 → auto-fail (incorrect accounting). CAQS Dimension 6 (Numerical) score = 0 → auto-fail (wrong answer). Auto-fail = REJECT, must be fully rewritten.
consensus_model.conflict_resolution: Agent disagreement: (a) identical evidence, different interpretation → escalate to Certification Board for human review. (b) different evidence (e.g., Agent 1 reports DL-030, Agent 3 reports no DL-030) → re-verify with independent within-object parse; determine which agent's extraction methodology is correct. (c) persistent member conflict across 3+ batches → escalate to Session Arbiter (new role — resolves inter-board deadlocks).
human_review_triggers: Any sub-dimension confidence < 80% → human reviews that dimension
Agent dissent on CERTIFIABLE vs. NEEDS_REVISION for same item
DL-010 flag (PG-002) — always requires human review due to high FP risk
Gold Standard candidate (100/100 rubric) — requires human sign-off per CAQS §14.4
DL-030 detection (answer-key error) — requires human confirmation before CC change

board_3_certification.charter: Final adjudication — CERTIFY / HOLD / ESCALATE decisions. ONLY board authorized to change question_state. Consumes evidence from Quality Board (quality verdict), Governance Board (pipeline authorization), Registry Board (item identity and delivery pool status), and Throughput Board (change classification). Performs governance-sufficiency review — is the evidence package complete, self-consistent, and sufficient for certification? — rather than re-performing content review.
what_it_does: CERTIFY — promote item to Certified state (question_state: In Audit → Certified). Trigger REVISION_HISTORY.md entry and Registry refresh.
HOLD — block certification pending specific conditions. Document remediation path (which Quality Board agent must re-verify, what specific fix is needed).
ESCALATE — requires human steward adjudication. Full evidence package provided. No autonomous action taken.
Verify ALL_AGREE consensus across all evidence dimensions — Quality Board sub-agents concur, Governance Board authorizes, Registry Board confirms identity.
Verify G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 certification-blocking conditions are all satisfied.
Verify governance guard Rules 1-5 compliance (Rule 2 BLOCK, Rule 5 ≤30 items/batch).
Produce certification batch summary: certified QIDs, before/after certified count, HOLD items with conditions.
what_it_does_not_do: Discover defects — pre-flight gate and Quality Board handle all defect detection
Author content — Quality Board produces revision requirements; remediation agents execute them
Perform structural scans — pre-flight gate runs all 12 automated scans; Quality Board Agent 3 adjudicates false positives
Re-verify accounting accuracy — Quality Board Agent 1 independently derives all CorrectChoice values
Re-evaluate distractor quality — Quality Board Agent 2 produces the 10-dimension rubric score
Re-run DL-008/026/013/016 scans — single pre-flight scan output consumed by all boards
Determine delivery pool eligibility — Registry Board maintains the canonical delivery pool inventory
Authorize session transitions — Governance Board owns SESSION_READY/PORTFOLIO_READY gates
Manage MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md — auto-generated by Registry Board (governance guard Rule 3)
Enforce backup protocol — Governance Board verifies BACKUP_PROTOCOL compliance
board_3_certification.scope_reduction_from_v1: In v1, Certification Board re-verified every other board's findings — full second review pass, 1.7:1 duplication at certification level, 6-7 agents redundantly confirming already-established quality verdicts. In v2, Certification Board trusts Quality Board's evidence package, performs governance-sufficiency review (evidence complete? self-consistent? sufficient for certification?), and makes the final CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE adjudication. Eliminates ~85% of current certification-level redundancy.

board_3_certification.agent_architecture: 1 agent — reads Quality Board verdict, Governance Board authorization, Registry Board identity data, Throughput Board change classification. Produces per-item CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decision. Does NOT re-review content. Does NOT re-run scans. Operates as governance-sufficiency reviewer — validates that all evidence is present, internally consistent, and meets certification standard.

MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md regenerated post-session (governance guard Rule 3)
No unexpected question_state drift — no decertification without REVISION_HISTORY.md entry
tier_2_session_close.blocking_level: HARD_BLOCK — session cannot close unless ALL conditions met. Unresolved conditions carry forward to next session as P0 blockers.

tier_3_portfolio_ready.description: Authorization for learner-facing content delivery. Gates when the application is being prepared for learner use.
gating_conditions: SESSION_READY (Tier 1 must be current — not stale)
Delivery pool safety: 0 Certified items with active DL-008, DL-030, DL-016, DL-021, DL-010 (confirmed) defects (GOV-AUTO-05)
Known-defective QID exclusion list current — cross-referenced against Registry Board delivery pool inventory
Pre-delivery-safety-check PASS (per AGENTS.md §7 and .opencode/skills/pre-delivery-safety-check.md)
0 items with question_state: Certified but missing from delivery pool inventory (Registry Board delivery pool completeness)
Portfolio health thresholds met: certified % ≥ current baseline (no regression), critical risk register = 0 active items
app.js scoring functions byte-identical to S17B baseline (scoring integrity)
Session 31 G1-G5 reconciliation current (within 7-day window per AGENTS.md §8 reconciliation schedule)
tier_3_portfolio_ready.blocking_level: HARD_BLOCK — learner delivery cannot proceed unless ALL conditions met. Any known-defective QID found in delivery pool → PORTFOLIO_QUARANTINED, immediate exclusion, root cause investigation.

automated_checks.check: Governance guard test suite — all 5 rules (Rules 1-5) pre-session + post-session. 27/27 tests per S726 upgrade.
T0 baseline hash verification — all 13 runtime-critical files vs. CURRENT_BASELINES.md (per AGENTS.md §13.1)
Tmid checkpoint — Pack D CAPA: hash, parse-count, FD-045/FD-046 presence, AD-075 Certified + app.js hash (per AGENTS.md §13.2)
automated_checks.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — if FAIL, halt all write agents, spawn governance agent, G1-G5 full reconciliation

automated_checks.check: Certified count stability — 2 independent verifications: Select-String direct grep + Function constructor parse. Must agree within 0.
Delivery pool safety — intersection of Certified QIDs (from Registry Board) ∩ known-defective QID list (from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md). Must be empty.
question_state drift detection — compare pre-session vs. post-session state distribution. Flag any unexpected decertification.
Portfolio health metrics — certified % by pack, section-level readiness, defect inventory, quality tier distribution vs. CAQS §6.1 targets
automated_checks.blocking: SOFT_BLOCK — report regression; does not block individual item operations

automated_checks.check: app.js hash integrity — pre/post hash comparison. If mismatch: run Sync Anomaly Playbook (Session 52 standard response: attribute → baseline-diff → classify → adopt-or-quarantine).
automated_checks.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — app.js change without governance authorization

automated_checks.check: BACKUP_PROTOCOL compliance — all files modified during session have timestamped .bak copies with non-zero size (per AGENTS.md §3)
automated_checks.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — close blocked if backup missing

automated_checks.check: REVISION_HISTORY.md entry verification — entry exists with required fields: QuestionIDs, before/after counts, date, author, verification results (per AGENTS.md §4)
automated_checks.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — session cannot close without REVISION_HISTORY entry

automated_checks.check: Session file-lock protocol — no other active session holds a write lock on any file this session intends to modify. If lock exists, delay and retry.
automated_checks.blocking: HARD_BLOCK — concurrent-write prevention per DL-019/028 resolution

board_4_governance.agent_architecture: 1 agent — reads all board outputs, runs automated governance checks, produces three-tier authorization decisions. Does NOT perform content review. Does NOT re-run scans. Operates as infrastructure gatekeeper — verifying that pipeline conditions are met, not re-creating quality evidence.

escalation_rules.trigger: Unexpected hash drift in any baseline file
escalation_rules.action: CRITICAL. Halt all agents. Spawn governance agent. Run G1-G5 reconciliation per Session 31 runbook. Attribute drift source. Classify as benign or content-significant. Adopt or quarantine.
CRITICAL. Halt all pack-write agents. Re-parse via Function constructor. If parse failure: investigate for DL-017 corruption. If parse succeeds but count ≠ 500: TIER 1 structural repair required.
HIGH. Spawn ledger-reconciliation agent. Verify via direct grep and Function constructor parse. Document discrepancy resolution. Only proceed when count stable across 2 consecutive independent scans.

escalation_rules.trigger: FD-045 or other critical QID missing
escalation_rules.action: HIGH. Escalate to TIER 1 structural repair per FD-045 Cross-Session Reference. Verify Pack D backup integrity. Halt Pack D certification until resolved.

escalation_rules.trigger: Known-defective QID found in delivery pool
escalation_rules.action: CRITICAL. IMMEDIATE QUARANTINE. Exclude from delivery pool. Root cause: why did Registry Board not flag it? Remediate exclusion list. Notify human steward.

governance_guard_rules_extended.description: question_state changes must pair with REVISION_HISTORY.md updates (existing)
ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty (existing — enforcement at Quality Board Agent 3 + Certification Board gate)
Answer-key changes must include a recomputed/independently verified note (existing)
Max 30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker (existing)
Pre-Flight Gate Passage Required. No item may transition to 'In Audit' or 'Certified' without a current same-session pre-flight gate PASS report (all Gates 1-4).
ExplanationWrong Distractor Completeness. All non-CorrectChoice EW slots must be present and non-empty (≥50 chars). Extends Rule 2 to cover DL-026/DL-021/DL-025.

Template Boilerplate Prohibition. No EW field may contain 'represents a plausible misconception', 'A candidate may select this option by misapplying', or DL-027 closing-tag variant. Warns at write time; certification blocked by Gate 2 SOFT_BLOCK.

board_4_governance.v1_board_mapping: BOARD_08 (Readiness Review Board — 90% unique) + Launch Board + Learner Safety Board (delivery pool gate function — 20% unique) + QA Board (governance guard enforcement function — partial from 75% unique)

board_5_throughput.charter: Measurement-only accountability board. Tracks certification pipeline throughput, per-session efficiency metrics, delta review effectiveness, and phase-gate certification. Does NOT own any certification decisions — is purely observational. Gates Phase 2 (board consolidation) and Phase 3 (optimization) activation behind measurable improvement benchmarks. Prevents deployment of the consolidated framework until v2 metrics demonstrate ≥20% improvement over v1 baselines.
what_it_does: Measure — capture T0 baseline metrics at session start and per-session delta at session end
Report — produce THROUGHPUT_REPORT.json with efficiency metrics, trend analysis, and phase-gate certification status
Gate — enforce HARD_BLOCK on Phase 2/3 activation if metrics haven't improved ≥20% over v1 baselines
Track — certification velocity (items/hour, items/session, sessions/wave), agent efficiency (agents per item, agents per certified item), delta review savings (items skipped %), report burden trend
what_it_does_not_do: CERTIFY items — that is Certification Board authority
Review content — that is Quality Board authority
Authorize sessions — that is Governance Board authority
Manage inventory — that is Registry Board authority
Modify question_state — measurement only, no write authority
Block individual items — metric reporting only; gate decisions are aggregate, not per-item

per_session.description: Total items in current certification batch scope
Items classified as content_change (full Quality Board review required)
Items classified as metadata_change (Agent 2 review only)
Items classified as structural_fix (automated pre-flight only)
Items classified as no_change (skip entirely — inherit prior verdict)
Items receiving CERTIFY decision in current session
Items receiving HOLD decision in current session
Total agent spawns across all boards (Registry: 0, Quality: 3-4, Governance: 1, Certification: 1, Throughput: 1)
Total report files written this session (target: ≤4 non-cert, ≤6 cert)
% of items in scope that had pre-flight gate violations (pre-board defect catch rate)
Total agent examinations of EW fields ÷ items_in_scope. Target: ≤1.3.
Number of independent DL-008/DL-026/DL-013 scan events per defect class this session. Target: 1 each.

per_wave_cumulative.description: % of newly Certified items found to have undetected defects in post-wave spot-check audit. Target: <1%.
% of delta review 'content_change' classifications that were actually unchanged (SHA-256 collision or methodology error). Target: <2%.
Total reports cross-referenced from governance documents ÷ total reports. Target: >90% consumed.

phase_gate_certification.description: Phase 2 (board consolidation) and Phase 3 (optimization) activation is gated behind measurable improvement benchmarks. Throughput Board certifies whether metrics justify proceeding to the next phase. HARD_BLOCK prevents deployment of consolidated framework until improvement is demonstrated.

activation_criteria: Registry Board: compound keys stable across 2 passes, certified count matches dual-verified grep (0 discrepancy)
Pre-flight gate: catches ≥85% of known defect classes (validated against DEFECT_LIBRARY.md known-defective QID list)
Delta ledger: SHA-256 hash stability confirmed across 2 independent passes, 0 mismatches on 5% deep-sample
Governance guard: 27/27 PASS with Rules 6-7 deployed (shadow mode, non-blocking)
Throughput metrics: delta review savings ≥50% (items skipped vs. full review), readiness failure rate ≤40% (down from 89.5%)
Throughput metrics: items per agent-hour ≥2.0× v1 baseline (v1: ~1.4 items/agent-hour estimated from S809: 38 items ÷ 28 agents)
phase_2_activation_gate.blocking_level: HARD_BLOCK — Phase 2 cannot begin unless ALL criteria met. Throughput Board issues PHASE2_CERTIFIED or PHASE2_BLOCKED.

activation_criteria: Quality Board: 3-agent CERTIFIABLE verdict agreement >95% vs. v1 multi-board verdicts (dual-run validated across 3 waves)
Delta review: ≥70% items skipped (i.e., genuinely unchanged between waves), 0 false-negative 'no_change' on items that were changed
Pre-flight gate: readiness failure rate ≤15% (items reaching Quality Board with 0 pre-flight violations)
Governance Board: shadow-mode SESSION_READY/PORTFOLIO_READY decisions match current Readiness + Launch decisions 100%
Certification Board: refocused CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions match dual-run full-review model 100%
Reporting: ≤8 files per session, ≥60% report consumption rate
Throughput metrics: agents per certification wave ≤10 (down from 15-28), sessions per wave ≤3 (down from 4-5)
phase_3_activation_gate.blocking_level: HARD_BLOCK — Phase 3 cannot begin unless ALL criteria met. Throughput Board issues PHASE3_CERTIFIED or PHASE3_BLOCKED.

t0_baseline_capture.description: At each session T0, capture v1 baseline metrics for comparison. Store in THROUGHPUT_BASELINES.json.

escalation_rules.trigger: Throughput metrics regress (e.g., agents/wave increases, items/hour decreases)
escalation_rules.action: WARN — report regression to Governance Board. Not blocking — does not halt certification. Triggers investigation into root cause (e.g., batch complexity, tooling inefficiency).

escalation_rules.trigger: Phase 2/3 activation gate metrics not improving after 3 waves
escalation_rules.action: ESCALATE — through Throughput Board recommendation to Governance Board: suspend further phase activation, investigate stalled improvement, recalibrate targets or re-scope framework redesign.
HARD_BLOCK — delta review infrastructure may be failing (false-positive hash changes, incorrect classification). Suspend delta review, revert to full review, investigate root cause.

board_5_throughput.v1_board_mapping: NEW board — added by S202 Amendment 2 as measurement-only accountability. No v1 equivalent. Prior v1 architecture had no board dedicated to throughput measurement; efficiency tracking was fragmented across Portfolio Impact Agent, Completion Forecast Agent, and Dashboard Compilation Agent — all producing overlapping metrics with no accountability gate.

board_state_machine.description: Complete state transition diagram for Framework v2. Six governance states with transitions owned by specific boards. Pre-conditions and post-conditions for every transition.

states.description: Item exists in pack file with no governance activity. No board has evaluated it.
states.owning_board: Registry Board (catalogues item, assigns compound key)

states.description: Item has undergone mandatory pre-flight gate (Gates 1-4, all 12 scans). Structural and content integrity verified.
Item entered Quality Board review. Sub-agents evaluating 10 CAQS dimensions.
Item requires structural or content revision. Remediation assigned to specific Quality Board agent.
states.owning_board: Quality Board (assigns remediation owner, routes back for re-review)

states.description: Item passed all gates and is eligible for learner delivery pool. question_state: Certified.
states.owning_board: Certification Board (EXCLUSIVE authority to write this state)

states.description: Item removed from active pool. Content preserved, question_state: Archived. Rollback log maintained.
states.owning_board: Registry Board (archival authorization) + Certification Board (state transition)

pre_conditions: Item exists in Registry with compound key (REG-05 verified)
Item parsed successfully via AM-1 Function Constructor
Item has QuestionID, Choices.{A,B,C,D}, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect present and non-empty
Item has all 4 ExplanationWrong[A-D] fields structurally present (DL-018 pass)
post_conditions: All 12 pre-flight scans complete (Gates 1-4)
HARD_BLOCK violations resolved (DL-008, DL-026, DL-021, DL-016, DL-030)
SOFT_BLOCK violations documented with remediation plan (DL-013, DL-031, DL-010 WARN)
PG-AUTO-00 Identity Validation PASS
Pre-Flight Report generated with per-gate PASS/FAIL/HOLD verdict

pre_conditions: All HARD_BLOCK violations resolved or documented with approved exception
Pre-Flight Report: all HARD_BLOCK gates PASS
Governance Board: SESSION_READY authorization active
Registry Board: compound key confirmed, delivery pool status current
post_conditions: Item assigned to Quality Board for CAQS 6-dimension verification
quality_state: InAudit (recorded in session manifest, not yet written to pack — Certification Board writes final state)
Quality Board batch assigned (≤30 items per governance guard Rule 5)

pre_conditions: Quality Board: ALL_AGREE consensus — CERTIFIABLE verdict
Quality Board: 10-dimension CAQS rubric score ≥ 90 (or ≥ 70 with documented exception)
Quality Board: ALL 6 dimensions at HIGH confidence (per CAQS §1.6 Build-Time AI Verification Standard)
Quality Board: All structural defects resolved (DL-008/026/018/021/025/016/010)
Quality Board: All content defects resolved (DL-013/027/030/031/009)
Governance Board: SESSION_READY current, PORTFOLIO_READY attested (or pre-delivery gate deferred)
Governance Board: Governance guard Rules 1-5 PASS (Rule 2: EW[CC] empty, Rule 5: batch ≤30 items)
Registry Board: Item compound key confirmed, NOT on known-defective QID list
Throughput Board: Item change classification recorded, delta ledger updated
G-NEW-1 through G-NEW-5 certification-blocking conditions all satisfied
EV1-EV8 explanation validation rules all satisfied
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry prepared with: QuestionIDs, verification results, before/after counts, distractor tier map
post_conditions: question_state written to pack file: 'Certified' (Certification Board writes this field)
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry committed (per AGENTS.md §4)
Registry Board notified: regenerate MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md
Delivery pool eligibility updated (Item now pulls into learner sessions per AGENTS.md §7)
Delta ledger updated: item content hash recorded for next wave's delta comparison
blocking_failures: Registry Board: item on known-defective list

pre_conditions: Quality Board verdict: NEEDS_REVISION on one or more dimensions
Specific revision requirements documented: which EW slot, what issue, remediation path
Remediation owner assigned (which Quality Board agent or remediation sub-agent)
post_conditions: Item routed to Quality Board sub-agent for remediation (EW authoring, CC verification, boilerplate removal)
Remediation batch ≤30 items (governance guard Rule 5)
Pre-remediation backup created per BACKUP_PROTOCOL (mandatory, AGENTS.md §3)
Post-remediation re-verification: same Quality Board agent re-evaluates remediated dimensions
transitions.transition_post_remediation: T05_EditorialQueue_to_InAudit — item returns to Quality Board for re-evaluation

pre_conditions: All remediation actions completed per revision requirements
Independent post-remediation verification: same defect class re-scanned, 0 regressions
Backup confirmed: timestamped .bak file with non-zero size
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry documenting remediation actions
post_conditions: Item re-enters Quality Board review for the remediated dimensions
If all dimensions pass → route to T03 (InAudit → Certified)
If still failing → additional remediation cycle or ESCALATE to Certification Board human steward

transitions.owning_board: Certification Board (state change) + Registry Board (archival authorization)
pre_conditions: Archival justification documented (e.g., clone consolidation per DL-012 remediation plan, defective item retirement, blueprint realignment)
Registry Board: canonical seed vs. clone designation confirmed
No items in delivery pool depend on this item (dependency chain verified)
Rollback log prepared: full item content archived, can be restored if needed
post_conditions: question_state written to pack file: 'Archived'
Item excluded from learner delivery pool (Registry Board delivery pool filter)
Archived content preserved — all fields retained, only state changes
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry documenting archival
Registry refreshed: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md regenerated

transitions.owning_board: Certification Board (EXCLUSIVE — requires documented re-verification request per QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.2)
pre_conditions: Explicit re-verification request documented — Certified → In Audit is a downgrade, requires explicit authorization
Trigger: DL-030 answer-key error discovered in Certified item (learner-safety CRITICAL)
Trigger: G-NEW certification-blocking condition violated in Certified item (pre-S508 items grandfathered but flagged)
Trigger: Governance Board delivery pool safety check found known-defective QID in delivery pool
post_conditions: question_state written to pack file: 'In Audit'
Item quarantined from delivery pool (Registry Board exclusion list updated)
Quality Board notified: item must undergo full re-review before re-certification
REVISION_HISTORY.md entry documenting decertification rationale
Governance Board: PORTFOLIO_READY re-evaluation required
transitions.blocking_note: Este es un downgrade serio. Certified → In Audit solo por pedido de re-verificación explícito. No puede ser aplicado automáticamente.

transitions.owning_board: Certification Board (batch review abandoned — return to unprocessed pool)
pre_conditions: Batch review abandoned — session closed without certification
All remediation actions documented (if any were performed)
Item retains its compound key and all content intact
post_conditions: question_state may be left as 'In Audit' or reverted to 'Unprocessed' per session closeout
Item remains in pack file unchanged — no content modification
Registry: item status updated
transitions.note: This is a rare transition — In Audit items normally proceed to Certified or EditorialQueue. This path exists for session-abandoned items where the audit was interrupted.

certification_board_exclusive.rationale: Certification Board is the ONLY board authorized to change question_state in pack files. This exclusive write authority prevents conflicting state changes from concurrent sessions (DL-019 resolution).

quality_board.rationale: Quality Board owns the remediation lifecycle. These transitions do not change question_state — they govern which Quality Board agent reviews which dimensions.

governance_board.rationale: Governance Board authorizes pipeline progression. Items cannot enter Quality Board review without SESSION_READY authorization.

pre_flight_gate_automated.rationale: Pre-flight gate is an automated scan pipeline, not a board. It runs without agent involvement. ~8 minutes for all 5 packs.

escalation_hierarchy.description: Complete escalation hierarchy for Framework v2. When boards disagree or issues cross board boundaries, this hierarchy determines which authority resolves the conflict. Based on COLLABORATION_MATRIX.md persona authority with v2 board adaptations.
escalation_hierarchy.principle: The correct expert always wins. No AI or board has unlimited authority. Higher boards override lower boards within their domain.

accounting_correctness.dispute: Two boards or agents disagree on accounting treatment, standard citation, or numerical result
accounting_correctness.winning_authority: Accountant persona — Quality Board Agent 1 has FINAL authority on accounting correctness. No other board may override.
accounting_correctness.decision_criteria: Is the accounting treatment correct under GAAP/COSO/IFRS/ASC as independently verified against Authoritative Accounting Sources (Tier 1: IMA CSO, Tier 2: COSO, Tier 3: textbooks)?
accounting_correctness.escalation_from: Certification Board → human steward if Agent 1 and Agent 2 disagree on interpretation and both cite authoritative sources

grammar_and_writing_clarity.dispute: Two boards disagree on wording, grammar, tone, or explanation clarity
grammar_and_writing_clarity.winning_authority: Editor persona — Quality Board Agent 2 has FINAL authority on writing quality. No other board may override.
cannot_be_overridden_by: Accountant (unless the wording creates an accounting ambiguity)
grammar_and_writing_clarity.note: If Accountant claims wording creates accounting ambiguity → escalation to both Agent 1 AND Agent 2 → if they still disagree → Certification Board human steward

difficulty_and_psychometrics.dispute: Two boards disagree on difficulty label, Bloom's level, distractor quality, or blueprint alignment
difficulty_and_psychometrics.winning_authority: Psychometrician persona — Quality Board Agent 2 has FINAL authority on difficulty and psychometrics.
difficulty_and_psychometrics.decision_criteria: Does the difficulty label match cognitive demand? Does Bloom's level align with question design? Do distractors represent genuine misconceptions per CAQS §6?

structural_compliance.dispute: Two boards disagree on whether a structural defect exists (e.g., is this slot empty? Is this CC correct?)
resolution_order: Pre-Flight Gate (independent re-scan with within-object extraction)
structural_compliance.winning_authority: Structural scans are automated — dispute resolution is re-execution with confirmed methodology. Agent 3 adjudicates scanner false positives. If Agent 3 and Pre-Flight disagree → escalate to Quality Board Nexus Agent for independent third-scan with different methodology.
structural_compliance.note: Structural defects are binary (field empty/non-empty, CC matches/doesn't match). Disagreement means ONE extraction methodology is wrong. Re-verify with AM-1 Function Constructor Parse as authoritative ground truth.

application_architecture.dispute: Quality Board or Certification Board reports rendering issue that affects app.js behavior
resolution_order: Certification Board (halt if app.js hash changed from baseline)
application_architecture.winning_authority: JavaScript Architect + Governance Board jointly. Application architecture changes require hash verification + Sync Anomaly Playbook (Session 52) documentation.
application_architecture.note: Content boards (Quality, Certification) NEVER modify application code. If a content issue requires an app.js change (e.g., rendering bug), it escalates to Governance Board → JavaScript Architect.

release_readiness.dispute: Two boards disagree on whether portfolio is ready for learner delivery
release_readiness.winning_authority: Governance Board wins on infrastructure readiness. Certification Board wins on item-level readiness. If they disagree (e.g., Governance says PORTFOLIO_READY but Certification says items need more work) → human steward.
release_readiness.decision_criteria: PORTFOLIO_READY gates: 0 known-defective QIDs in delivery pool, app.js hash stable, certified count verified, governance guard PASS. If all gates pass but a board objects → human steward adjudicates with full evidence package.

board_authority_dispute.dispute: Two boards claim authority over the same decision (e.g., Quality Board vs. Governance Board on pre-certification readiness)
resolution_order: Session Arbiter (new role — resolves inter-board deadlocks)
board_authority_dispute.winning_authority: Session Arbiter — when boards of equal rank disagree on jurisdiction. Session Arbiter is the only authority that can rule on board-boundary disputes.
board_authority_dispute.qualifications: Session Arbiter must be an agent that has no stake in either board's decision. Must cite AGENTS.md, CAQS, PROJECT_CONSTITUTION to determine which board owns the disputed scope. If unclear → human steward.
board_authority_dispute.note: Most board-boundary disputes are resolvable by reference to this architecture document: Registry owns identity, Quality owns content evaluation, Governance owns pipeline authorization, Certification owns state transitions, Throughput owns measurement. If a decision is not clearly owned by one board, the Session Arbiter assigns temporary ownership and proposes an architecture amendment.

escalation_conditions_that_halt_all_writ: Unexpected hash drift in any baseline file (CRITICAL — Governance Board triggers G1-G5)
Pack parse-count change ≠ 500 (CRITICAL — halt all pack-write agents)
DL-030 answer-key error in Certified item (CRITICAL — learner-safety, immediate quarantine)
Known-defective QID in delivery pool (CRITICAL — immediate exclusion, root cause investigation)
Concurrent session lock conflict (CRITICAL — DL-019 prevention: pre-write hash ≠ post-write hash on items not in delta inventory)
Governance guard Rule 2/3/5 violation (BLOCK level — session cannot proceed until resolved)

concurrent_write_risk.v1: 6+ boards writing to packs (2 confirmed DL-019/DL-028 incidents)
concurrent_write_risk.v2: 2 boards writing to packs (Quality + Certification) + session-level file-lock

certification_authority.v1: Certification Board re-verifies all evidence (1.7:1 duplication)
certification_authority.v2: Certification Board trusts Quality Board evidence — governance-sufficiency review only

phase_1_foundation.target: Build three infrastructure pillars: compound-key registry, pre-flight gate (Gates 1-4), SHA-256 delta ledger. All operate alongside current 8-board structure — no board changes yet.
deliverables: P1.1: Compound-Key Registry (S202-S203) — build MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md with within-object Function constructor parse, generate template family map, implement compound key field schema
P1.2: Pre-Flight Gate (S204-S205) — Gates 1-4 automated scans (12 total), governance guard Rules 6-7 added (shadow mode), PG-AUTO-00 Identity Validation
P1.3: Delta Ledger (S206-S207) — SHA-256 content hashing on canonical JSON serialization, generate initial DELTA_LEDGER.json, cross-validate 5% sample with manual extraction
phase_1_foundation.activation_gate: S830 closeout. Independent audit confirms: (a) Registry compound keys resolve to correct items, (b) pre-flight gate catches all known defect classes with <5% FP rate, (c) delta ledger hash stability confirmed.

phase_2_consolidation.target: Merge 8 boards into 5. Activate Quality Board 3-agent unified review. Integrate delta review. Governance Board goes LIVE in shadow mode.
deliverables: P2.1: Quality Board Consolidation (S208-S213) — merge Technical + DQS + EQS + Learner Safety (content) + QA (structural) into 3-agent Quality Board, 3 dual-run certification waves, retire boards 1-6 after validation
P2.2: Delta Review Activation (S210-S213) — integrate delta pre-flight into session startup, classify items at T0, dry-run alongside full review on 1 wave
P2.3: Governance Board Shadow Mode (S214-S215) — implement GOV-AUTO-01 through GOV-AUTO-11, run in shadow for 3 sessions, validate decisions match current gates 100%
phase_2_consolidation.activation_gate: S900 closeout. Throughput Board PHASE2_CERTIFIED required. Must demonstrate ≥20% improvement across: agents/wave, reports/session, duplication ratio, readiness failure rate.

phase_3_optimization.target: Reduce reporting to 4 files/session. Implement Pre-Flight Gates 3-4. Refocus Certification Board. Add Governance guard Rule 8. Enter continuous improvement cycle.
deliverables: P3.1: Reporting Consolidation (S216-S217) — merge all dashboard variants into single DASHBOARD.json, eliminate agent-standalone outputs, standardize file naming to SESSIONXXX_ prefix
P3.2: Advanced Pre-Flight Gates 3-4 (S218-S220) — Gate 3 Identity Reconciliation, Gate 4 Calculation Validation
P3.3: Certification Board Refocus + Rule 8 (S221-S222) — refocus from evidence re-verification to governance-sufficiency review, run dual-batch comparison
phase_3_optimization.activation_gate: S920 closeout. Throughput Board PHASE3_CERTIFIED required. Must demonstrate: defect escape rate <1%, agents/wave ≤7, reports/session ≤6, wall clock/wave ≤8 hours.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Adopt Compound-Key Identity Model
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Adopt. Foundation for Registry Board, pre-flight gate identity validation, delta review. Without: DL-029, S320, DL-008 phantom counts persist.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Mandate AM-1 Function Constructor Parse for All Scans
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Mandate. Eliminates DL-029 forward-scan false positives (~8 sessions saved). Within-object extraction is the ONLY approved method.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Approve 5-Board Consolidation Target
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Approve. Registry + Quality + Governance + Certification + Throughput. UIQS as Quality Board Agent 4 (optional, per-pack). If UI defects slip through after 3 waves, escalate to standalone 6th board at S920.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Commit to Delta Review with Phased Adoption
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Full delta review with conservative scanner override. 5-10% deep-sampling verification. If defect escape rate >3% after 3 waves, revert to full review.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Enforce Reporting Reduction Targets
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Soft cap: max 8 files/session. Phased to 4 by S910. 8-file cap stops runaway 29-file sessions while allowing gradual output format transition.

dependent_decisions_required.title: Authorize Session-Level File Lock Protocol
dependent_decisions_required.recommendation: Exclusive session model: only 1 session modifies any given pack file at a time. .lock files at pack level. Pre-write/post-write hash reconciliation as safety net.

migration_risks.title: Quality Board false-negatives exceed current multi-board detection
migration_risks.mitigation: 3-wave dual-run validation. Must achieve >95% agreement. If Quality Board misses DL-030 class defect → fix prompts, re-validate.

migration_risks.title: Delta review false-negative — changed item classified as 'no_change'
migration_risks.mitigation: Conservative scanner override. 5-10% random spot-check hash verification per wave. If ANY hash wrong → full re-audit of entire pack.

migration_risks.title: Concurrent-write overwrite during transition
migration_risks.mitigation: Phase 1 tools are read-only. Phase 2 writes gated by pre-write hash reconciliation. Session-registry.lock protocol. Post-remediation reconciliation: re-hash ALL items → compare to pre-flight.

migration_risks.title: Governance guard Rules 6-8 false-positive blocks
migration_risks.mitigation: Rules 6-7 deployed as shadow-mode (non-blocking) for 3 waves before becoming authoritative. Rule 8 is WARN only. Documented exception mechanism for overrides.

migration_risks.title: Registry Board drift from pack file content
migration_risks.mitigation: Registry auto-generated at T0, Tmid, Tend. Never hand-edited. Governance Board SESSION_CLOSE requires registry hash match. Pack files are canonical; registry is derived.

migration_risks.title: UIQS quality decline as sub-function of Quality Board
migration_risks.mitigation: Agent 4 activation rule: mandatory once per pack per session. If UI defects slip: transition to standalone 6th board at S920 boundary per S201 Board 6 analysis.

revision.notes: Initial Framework v2 architecture specification. Five-board operating model (Registry, Quality, Certification, Governance, Throughput). Based on S200 10-agent assessment + S201 10-board consolidation study. S202 Amendment 2 added Throughput Board as measurement-only accountability with phase-gate certification. All boards mapped from current 8-board v1 structure. Pre-flight gate integrated as automated scan pipeline (12 scans, 5 gates). Delta review architecture defined. Certified pool: 2,031 at time of writing.
